added: Memos can carry their own colour and icon. A memo linked to a chore or task borrows that item's category colour and glyph (following your Colours settings); a standalone memo gets its own, chosen from the bell in the edit sheet.
changed: The memo list badge now only shows when a memo rings, with no verb: "today 1:55 PM" for the next ring, "2h ago" once it has rung. The Active and Done filters already say which is which.
fixed: A completed task no longer keeps a coloured urgency spine in the Done list; a done task's card is now fully muted.
Hardened the Alarm-style ring path with a regression test so it cannot silently fall back to the muted notification stream again.
